messages.subject: Project Cedar — heads of terms (first draft)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

As promised, our first draft heads of terms. The key commercial points reflect what the principals discussed: 5-year term, £148.5k per shipset Year 1 with a volume discount ladder, £2.4m NRE, and a 60-shipset Year-1 minimum. We've included a binding exclusivity period to the end of the year and confirmed the NDA continues.

The one point I'd flag is exclusivity scope — our client wants it broad. I expect you'll push back; happy to discuss.

Adam

messages.subject: RE: Project Cedar — heads of terms (first draft)
messages.plaintextBody:
Adam,

Thanks. Broadly aligned on the commercials. As anticipated, the exclusivity drafting is too wide for us — Halstead can't agree to a term-long, worldwide ban that catches its general composite business. We've revised the scope to the specific CM-7 assemblies and kept the binding exclusivity window for the negotiation. I attach our turn; if the principals are content I'll have Robert and your client sign tomorrow.

Otherwise the document is largely agreed.

Kind regards,
James
